SURFER QUANTFX · MULTI-PAIR STRATEGY

Surfer forex EA: a multi-pair trading strategy

Surfer EA trades four USD currency pairs as a portfolio. It trails profits during sustained moves and can lock positions in extreme trends. The combined USD exposure matters across all four pairs.

SurferSurfer strategy family
01

Trading logic

The system switches between trend-following and counter-trend positioning. As a swing extends, the trailing exit adjusts with price. An extreme directional move can trigger an offsetting position. Scaling and unlocking rules depend on the Classic, Radical or Million version.

02

Risks & boundaries

All four pairs include the US dollar. Buying dollars across several pairs concentrates the same directional exposure. Locked positions still use margin and incur costs, and some historical versions add to losing positions.

03

Operating requirements

The source lists EUR/USD, GBP/USD, USD/JPY and USD/CHF, with about 100 lots of daily volume. Review contract sizes for each pair, whether the account permits hedging and how margin is calculated on locked positions.
